findings.title: Safe import of Sequence from collections.abc
findings.description: Added import of 'Sequence' from collections.abc for use in JsonType definition. This is a standard library import and does not introduce a security vulnerability in itself.
findings.suggestion: No action required. This is a safe, standard library import used for type hinting. Continue to monitor dependency versions, but this specific line presents no direct security risk.

findings.title: Type alias update for JsonType using Sequence/Mapping
findings.description: Updated JsonType type alias to use Sequence and Mapping instead of list and dict for recursive JSON structure definitions. This is a type-level change for better compatibility with various JSON-like structures (tuples, user-defined mappings). It does not affect runtime security, injection, or data exposure as it is limited to the TYPE_CHECKING block (if TYPE_CHECKING:).
findings.suggestion: No security action required. This is a type annotation improvement that broadens the accepted JSON-like structures for static analysis tools. It does not change runtime behavior or introduce vulnerabilities.
